## S1807 -- the four base change properties of `bc = FiniteEtale.baseChange K Kbar` (2026-11-01)

- Deliverable: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1807BaseChangeFiberActual.lean` (17208 bytes, SHA256
  `F939DE68A29D41CDBE2DCF543A32D1FBC314FCBD48ECB2FB7E956CA178FED884`); olean
  `.lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1807BaseChangeFiberActual.olean` (396448 bytes,
  copy also in the source dir). Verification: `lake env lean -o ...` -> EXIT=0, no errors, no
  warnings; import check `_S1807ImportProbe.lean` (imports the olean, `#check` on the four
  conditions) -> EXIT=0; `#print axioms` for all eight declarations -> exactly
  `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- Proved (3 of the 4 S1769 conditions, unconditional for every field `K`):
  `S1807.bcPreservesFiniteProducts` (`PreservesFiniteProducts (bc K)`),
  `S1807.bcPreservesEpis` (`PreservesEpimorphisms (bc K).op`),
  `S1807.bcPreservesQuotients` (`forall G [Group G] [Finite G],
  PreservesColimitsOfShape (SingleObj G) (bc K).op`). The four conditions are restated verbatim
  in namespace `S1807` (S1769's olean did not exist at the time), `S1807.bc K` is
  definitionally S1769's `bc K`.
- Stronger theorem proved: `S1807.bc_preservesFiniteLimits : PreservesFiniteLimits (bc K)`.
  Route: (a) products = the `Pi` algebra (`piFan`, `piFanIsLimit` in
  `CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale R`) and base change on it is `Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight`
  (`piRight_comp_eval`); (b) equalizers = `↥(AlgHom.equalizer f g)` (`eqFork`,
  `eqForkIsLimit`; etaleness is `S1770.etale_subalgebra`) and base change on it is
  `AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv`, using `Module.Flat K Kbar` (`tensorEqualizer_comp_eqι`).
  (c) assembly `preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesEqualizers_and_finiteProducts`.
  Monomorphisms: a mono `f` has `HasPullback f f` with iso diagonal (`monoSelfPullback`),
  then `PreservesPullback.iso_inv_fst`; `op_epi_iff` converts monos of `bc K` into epis of
  `(bc K).op`. Quotients: `preservesColimitsOfShape_op` +
  `FinCategory (SingleObj G)ᵒᵖ` (from `SingleObj.finCategoryOfFintype` and
  `finCategoryOpposite`).
- First missing (also first in S1769's field order): `BCPreservesPullbacks K` =
  `PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan (bc K).op` = pushout preservation; it does NOT follow
  from finite-limit preservation. Concretely it needs the coherence
  `Kbar ⊗[K] (B ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[Kbar] (Kbar ⊗[K] B) ⊗[Kbar ⊗[K] A] (Kbar ⊗[K] C)` compatible with
  the four canonical maps. Mathlib has no such statement; nearest are
  `Algebra.IsPushout.tensorProduct_tensorProduct` (the square `A → B`, `A → A ⊗[R] S`,
  `B → B ⊗[R] S` is a pushout), `IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg` (`B ⊗[A] C ≃ₐ[S] S ⊗[R] C`
  when `B = S ⊗[R] A`) and `Algebra.IsPushout.comp_iff` (cancellation of a left pushout square
  in a rectangle). Also available: S1745's `tensorCocone`/`tensorCocone_isColimit`, the closure
  of `CommAlgCat.finiteEtale K` under `WalkingSpan`-colimits, and
  `walkingCospanOpEquiv : WalkingCospanᵒᵖ ≌ WalkingSpan`.
- Reusable pitfalls: (1) morphisms of `ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory` are wrappers
  `{ hom : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj }`, so `CommAlgCat.ofHom` does not elaborate to a full-subcategory
  morphism; use `ObjectProperty.homMk`. (2) `CommAlgCat.of R ↑X` and a stored
  `X : CommAlgCat R` are not always definitionally equal (instance terms differ), so prefer
  `FiniteEtale.ofHom` when the instances are in scope, and keep all constructions on one
  `FiniteEtale.of`-normal form. (3) `Algebra.TensorProduct.ext` takes the two composites with
  `includeLeft`/`includeRight`; for the pointwise `forall a b, f (a ⊗ b) = g (a ⊗ b)` form use
  `Algebra.TensorProduct.ext'`. (4) `[Finite G]` does not yield `Fintype G` by typeclass
  search; add `letI : Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G`. (5) `Fork.IsLimit.mk` elaborates the
  lift before the side goals; introduce the cone variable with `intro s` in each goal rather
  than closing the lift's side condition inside the lambda.
- Environment note: many concurrent lake/lean processes; intermittent
  "failed to read file ...olean" errors occurred on this shared workspace, all final builds
  succeeded on retry.

arguments.description: Append S1807 entry to audit ledger
arguments.command: $c = Get-Content D:\lean\tmp\s1807_audit_entry.md -Raw -Encoding utf8; Add-Content -Path D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Value $c -Encoding utf8; Get-Content D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 6; Remove-Item D:\lean\tmp\s1807_audit_entry.md; Remove-Item D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\_S1807ImportProbe.lean -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
